import FS2.DuplexTrace

/-! Structural transport facts for extending an oracle trace by a suffix. -/
set_option autoImplicit false
namespace AspisR1.TraceAppend

open FS FS2 FS2.Duplex
open AspisV8R19.MemoizedProgramLaw
open AspisV8PairedCommitment

variable {I A : Type} [DecidableEq I]

theorem tableBefore_append (t : Table I A) (tr tail : List (I × A)) (a : I)
    (ha : a ∈ tr.map Prod.fst) :
    tableBefore t (tr ++ tail) a = tableBefore t tr a := by
  induction tr generalizing t with
  | nil => simp at ha
  | cons q rest ih =>
      obtain ⟨i, v⟩ := q
      by_cases hia : i = a
      · subst i
        simp [List.cons_append, tableBefore]
      · have hrest : a ∈ rest.map Prod.fst := by
          simp only [List.map_cons, List.mem_cons] at ha
          rcases ha with h | h
          · exact (hia h.symm).elim
          · exact h
        simp only [List.cons_append, tableBefore, hia, if_false]
        rw [ih (put t i v) hrest]

theorem traceFrom_append (tr tail : List (I × A)) (a : I)
    (ha : a ∈ tr.map Prod.fst) :
    traceFrom (tr ++ tail) a = traceFrom tr a ++ tail := by
  induction tr with
  | nil => simp at ha
  | cons q rest ih =>
      obtain ⟨i, v⟩ := q
      by_cases hia : i = a
      · subst i
        simp [List.cons_append, traceFrom]
      · have hrest : a ∈ rest.map Prod.fst := by
          simp only [List.map_cons, List.mem_cons] at ha
          rcases ha with h | h
          · exact (hia h.symm).elim
          · exact h
        simp only [List.cons_append, traceFrom, hia, if_false]
        exact ih hrest

theorem firstReads_le_append (t : Table I A) (tr tail : List (I × A)) :
    firstReads t tr ≤ firstReads t (tr ++ tail) := by
  induction tr generalizing t with
  | nil => simp [firstReads]
  | cons q rest ih =>
      obtain ⟨i, v⟩ := q
      simp only [List.cons_append, firstReads]
      have h := ih (put t i v)
      omega

theorem hitsBad_of_prefix (bad : I → Table I A → A → Prop)
    (t : Table I A) (tr tail : List (I × A)) :
    hitsBad bad t tr → hitsBad bad t (tr ++ tail) := by
  induction tr generalizing t with
  | nil => simp [hitsBad]
  | cons q rest ih =>
      obtain ⟨i, v⟩ := q
      simp only [List.cons_append, hitsBad]
      intro h
      rcases h with hfirst | hrest
      · exact Or.inl hfirst
      · exact Or.inr (ih (put t i v) hrest)

#print axioms tableBefore_append
#print axioms traceFrom_append
#print axioms firstReads_le_append
#print axioms hitsBad_of_prefix

end AspisR1.TraceAppend

import R1UnifiedSamplerPublic
import R1DuplexSamplers
import R1QuerySamplerBridge
import R1RowZeroCodec
import R1OpeningReseedFrame
import R1TranscriptView

/-! One sampler schedule for the 33 R1 challenges. Public bytes exclude C1:
C1 is the first prover message. This is an abstract-codec byte model, not a
Rust refinement, complete FS decoder, or security theorem. Wrong message
constructors use an explicit totalization branch and must be rejected by a
future protocol decision/classifier. -/
set_option autoImplicit false
noncomputable section
namespace AspisR1.UnifiedSampler

open FS FS2 FS2.Duplex
open AspisV8R19.DuplexFrames AspisV8R19.SourceDuplexStep
open AspisV8R19.MemoizedProgramLaw AspisV8R19.OracleProgramOps
open TranscriptView

variable {M Cv : Type} {L : Nat}


abbrev Prefix (M Cv : Type) (L : Nat) :=
  FS.Prefix (Public L) (Message M) (Challenge Cv)

def roundCount : Nat := 33

def stateOf (p : Params M Cv L) (P : Prefix M Cv L) : State :=
  match P.rounds.getLast? with
  | none => p.iv
  | some (_, ch) => ch.2

def absorb (p : Params M Cv L) (i : Nat) (P : Prefix M Cv L) (m : M) : Addr L :=
  absorbA p (stateOf p P) (p.lbl i) (p.enc m) (p.encLen m)

def messageValid : Nat → Message M → Prop
  | 0, .initial _ => True
  | _ + 1, .payload _ => True
  | _, _ => False

/-- Defined only to totalize the sampler outside the valid message schedule. -/
def invalid (p : Params M Cv L) : Sampler (Addr L) State (Challenge Cv) :=
  .ask (squeezeA p p.iv) fun _ => .done (.queries (.error 0), p.iv)

def liftQuery (r : AspisV8R19.Q22SamplerProgram.Result) : Challenge Cv :=
  (.queries r.1, r.2)

def samp (p : Params M Cv L) (hD : 5 ≤ p.D) (i : Nat)
    (P : Prefix M Cv L) (m : Message M) : Sampler (Addr L) State (Challenge Cv) :=
  match i, m with
  | 0, .initial c1 =>
      DuplexSamplers.initial p
        (PublicInitFrame.addr P.statement.pubBytes P.statement.initFits c1)
        (PublicInitFrame.row0 p hD) 0 liftChallenge
  | 0, .payload _ => invalid p
  | j + 1, .payload msg =>
      let a := absorb p (j + 1) P msg
      if j + 1 = 26 then
        DuplexSamplers.reseeded p a
          (OpeningReseedFrame.addr P.statement.tag (by have := P.statement.initFits; omega))
          (j + 1) liftChallenge
      else if j + 1 = 31 then
        QuerySamplerBridge.sampler p a liftQuery
      else DuplexSamplers.plain p a (j + 1) liftChallenge
  | _ + 1, .initial _ => invalid p

theorem stateOf_ext (p : Params M Cv L) (P : Prefix M Cv L)
    (m : Message M) (ch : Challenge Cv) :
    stateOf p (P.ext m ch) = ch.2 := by
  simp [stateOf, FS.Prefix.ext]

theorem row_zero (p : Params M Cv L) (hD : 5 ≤ p.D)
    (P : Prefix M Cv L) (c1 : State) :
    samp p hD 0 P (.initial c1) = DuplexSamplers.initial p
      (PublicInitFrame.addr P.statement.pubBytes P.statement.initFits c1)
      (PublicInitFrame.row0 p hD) 0 liftChallenge := rfl

theorem row_reseed (p : Params M Cv L) (hD : 5 ≤ p.D)
    (P : Prefix M Cv L) (m : M) :
    samp p hD 26 P (.payload m) = DuplexSamplers.reseeded p (absorb p 26 P m)
      (OpeningReseedFrame.addr P.statement.tag (by have := P.statement.initFits; omega))
      26 liftChallenge := rfl

theorem row_query (p : Params M Cv L) (hD : 5 ≤ p.D)
    (P : Prefix M Cv L) (m : M) :
    samp p hD 31 P (.payload m) =
      QuerySamplerBridge.sampler p (absorb p 31 P m) liftQuery := rfl

theorem row_ordinary (p : Params M Cv L) (hD : 5 ≤ p.D)
    (i : Nat) (hi0 : i ≠ 0) (hi26 : i ≠ 26) (hi31 : i ≠ 31)
    (P : Prefix M Cv L) (m : M) :
    samp p hD i P (.payload m) =
      DuplexSamplers.plain p (absorb p i P m) i liftChallenge := by
  cases i with
  | zero => contradiction
  | succ i => simp only [samp, hi26, hi31, ↓reduceIte]

theorem row_rho (p : Params M Cv L) (hD : 5 ≤ p.D)
    (P : Prefix M Cv L) (m : M) :
    samp p hD 32 P (.payload m) =
      DuplexSamplers.plain p (absorb p 32 P m) 32 liftChallenge := rfl

theorem firstCell_some (p : Params M Cv L) (hD : 5 ≤ p.D)
    (i : Nat) (P : Prefix M Cv L) (m : Message M) :
    firstCell (samp p hD i P m) ≠ none := by
  cases i with
  | zero => cases m <;> simp [samp, invalid, DuplexSamplers.initial, firstCell]
  | succ i =>
      cases m with
      | initial c1 => simp [samp, invalid, firstCell]
      | payload msg =>
          by_cases h26 : i + 1 = 26 <;> by_cases h31 : i + 1 = 31 <;>
            simp [samp, h26, h31, DuplexSamplers.reseeded,
              QuerySamplerBridge.sampler, DuplexSamplers.plain, firstCell]

#print axioms stateOf_ext
#print axioms row_zero
#print axioms row_reseed
#print axioms row_query
#print axioms row_ordinary
#print axioms row_rho
#print axioms firstCell_some

end AspisR1.UnifiedSampler
end

import R1InputWitnessCheck
import PublicOptionShape
import AspisV8R15.ExactTowerBase
import R1SpendAppendBinding

/-! An explicit witness and decidable semantic spend relation. The concrete
witness field is M31; the generic version supports the existing algebraic
extraction proofs. This is not a byte parser or a Rust refinement theorem.
Values are bounded nonnegative integers, as in the production value theorem;
the honest pair-forest builder's stronger positivity contract is separate. -/
set_option autoImplicit false
namespace AspisR1.SpendRelation

open R0P AspisPool.V7PairLeafOccupancy

structure Witness (K : Type) where
  inputValue : Fin (2^30)
  outputValue : Fin (2^30)
  changeValue : Fin (2^30)
  sk : R0P.Digest K
  salt : R0P.Digest K
  path : Fin 24 → Bool × R0P.Digest K
  pair : PairLeaf K
  recipientOwner : R0P.Digest K
  recipientSalt : R0P.Digest K
  changeOwner : R0P.Digest K
  changeSalt : R0P.Digest K

variable {K : Type} [Field K] [DecidableEq K]

def recipientCommitment (pub : Public K) (w : Witness K) : R0P.Digest K :=
  noteCommitment w.recipientOwner (w.outputValue.val : K) pub.assetId w.recipientSalt

def changeCommitment (pub : Public K) (w : Witness K) : R0P.Digest K :=
  noteCommitment w.changeOwner (w.changeValue.val : K) pub.assetId w.changeSalt

def variantOutput (pub : Public K) (w : Witness K) : Prop :=
  match pub.variant with
  | .privateTransfer => pub.recipient = some (recipientCommitment pub w)
  | .withdrawal => pub.withdrawalAmount = some (w.outputValue.val : K)

def Rspend (pub : Public K) (w : Witness K) : Prop :=
  PublicOptionShape.canonical pub ∧
    InputWitnessCore.Relation pub (w.inputValue.val : K) w.sk w.salt w.path w.pair ∧
    w.inputValue.val = w.outputValue.val + w.changeValue.val ∧
    pub.change = changeCommitment pub w ∧
    variantOutput pub w ∧ AppendBinding pub

def variantOutputCheck (pub : Public K) (w : Witness K) : Bool :=
  match pub.variant with
  | .privateTransfer =>
      match pub.recipient with
      | none => false
      | some recipient => InputWitnessCheck.digestEqCheck recipient (recipientCommitment pub w)
  | .withdrawal =>
      match pub.withdrawalAmount with
      | none => false
      | some amount => decide (amount = (w.outputValue.val : K))

def check (pub : Public K) (w : Witness K) : Bool :=
  PublicOptionShape.check pub &&
    InputWitnessCheck.check pub (w.inputValue.val : K) w.sk w.salt w.path w.pair &&
    decide (w.inputValue.val = w.outputValue.val + w.changeValue.val) &&
    InputWitnessCheck.digestEqCheck pub.change (changeCommitment pub w) &&
    variantOutputCheck pub w && appendCheck pub

/-- The concrete relation uses canonical M31 field elements for every key,
salt, path digest, pair coordinate and output owner. -/
abbrev Wspend := Witness AspisV8R15.ExactTowerBase.M31Exact

def checkM31 (pub : Public AspisV8R15.ExactTowerBase.M31Exact) (w : Wspend) : Bool :=
  check pub w

theorem variantOutputCheck_eq_true_iff (pub : Public K) (w : Witness K) :
    variantOutputCheck pub w = true ↔ variantOutput pub w := by
  cases hv : pub.variant with
  | privateTransfer =>
      cases hr : pub.recipient <;>
        simp [variantOutputCheck, variantOutput, hv, hr,
          InputWitnessCheck.digestEqCheck_eq_true_iff]
  | withdrawal =>
      cases ha : pub.withdrawalAmount <;>
        simp [variantOutputCheck, variantOutput, hv, ha]

theorem check_eq_true_iff (pub : Public K) (w : Witness K) :
    check pub w = true ↔ Rspend pub w := by
  simp only [check, Bool.and_eq_true, decide_eq_true_eq,
    PublicOptionShape.check_eq_true_iff, InputWitnessCheck.check_eq_true_iff,
    InputWitnessCheck.digestEqCheck_eq_true_iff, variantOutputCheck_eq_true_iff,
    appendCheck_eq_true_iff, Rspend, and_assoc]

theorem input_note_extracted (pub : Public K) (w : Witness K) (A : Trace K)
    (hvalue : A 10 1008 = (w.inputValue.val : K)) (h : Rspend pub w) :
    R0P.InputNoteExtracted pub A := by
  refine ⟨w.sk, w.salt, w.path, h.2.1.nullifier, ?_⟩
  rw [hvalue]
  exact h.2.1.membership

theorem integer_bounds (pub : Public K) (w : Witness K) (h : Rspend pub w) :
    w.inputValue.val < 2^30 ∧ w.outputValue.val < 2^30 ∧ w.changeValue.val < 2^30 ∧
      w.inputValue.val = w.outputValue.val + w.changeValue.val :=
  ⟨w.inputValue.isLt, w.outputValue.isLt, w.changeValue.isLt, h.2.2.1⟩

#print axioms input_note_extracted
#print axioms integer_bounds
#print axioms variantOutputCheck_eq_true_iff
#print axioms check_eq_true_iff
end AspisR1.SpendRelation

import Mathlib.Algebra.Polynomial.Roots
import Mathlib.Data.Fintype.Card

/-! Finite-family polynomial root counting for a direct joint-list binding.

This file proves only a finite root-union bound and its pointwise outside
consequence. It introduces no uniqueness premise or protocol-security claim. -/

set_option autoImplicit false

noncomputable section

namespace AspisR1

open Polynomial

variable {K T : Type*} [Field K] [Fintype K] [DecidableEq K]

/-- Candidate values where at least one nonzero family polynomial vanishes. -/
def functionalBadRoots (ts : Finset T) (polys : T → K[X]) : Finset K :=
  ts.biUnion (fun t =>
    if polys t = 0 then ∅ else
      Finset.univ.filter (fun x : K => (polys t).eval x = 0))

/-- The union of the nonzero members' root sets costs at most the sum of
their degree bounds. -/
theorem functional_bad_roots_card_le
    (ts : Finset T) (polys : T → K[X]) (degreeBound : Nat)
    (hdegree : ∀ t ∈ ts, (polys t).natDegree ≤ degreeBound) :
    (functionalBadRoots ts polys).card ≤ ts.card * degreeBound := by
  classical
  calc
    (functionalBadRoots ts polys).card ≤
        ∑ t ∈ ts, (if polys t = 0 then ∅ else
          Finset.univ.filter (fun x : K => (polys t).eval x = 0)).card :=
      Finset.card_biUnion_le
    _ ≤ ∑ _t ∈ ts, degreeBound := by
      apply Finset.sum_le_sum
      intro t ht
      by_cases hp : polys t = 0
      · simp [hp]
      · have hsubset :
            (Finset.univ.filter (fun x : K => (polys t).eval x = 0)) ⊆
              (polys t).roots.toFinset := by
          intro x hx
          rw [Finset.mem_filter] at hx
          rw [Multiset.mem_toFinset, (polys t).mem_roots hp]
          exact hx.2
        calc
          (if polys t = 0 then ∅ else
              Finset.univ.filter (fun x : K => (polys t).eval x = 0)).card
              = (Finset.univ.filter (fun x : K => (polys t).eval x = 0)).card := by
                  simp [hp]
          _ ≤ (polys t).roots.toFinset.card := Finset.card_le_card hsubset
          _ ≤ (polys t).roots.card := Multiset.toFinset_card_le _
          _ ≤ (polys t).natDegree := (polys t).card_roots'
          _ ≤ degreeBound := hdegree t ht
    _ = ts.card * degreeBound := by simp

#print axioms functional_bad_roots_card_le

/-- A zero of an in-family polynomial outside the bad union forces that
polynomial to be identically zero. -/
theorem eval_zero_outside_functional_bad_roots
    (ts : Finset T) (polys : T → K[X]) (x : K)
    (hout : x ∉ functionalBadRoots ts polys)
    (t : T) (ht : t ∈ ts) (heval : (polys t).eval x = 0) :
    polys t = 0 := by
  classical
  by_contra hp
  have hx : x ∈ (if polys t = 0 then ∅ else
      Finset.univ.filter (fun y : K => (polys t).eval y = 0)) := by
    simp [hp, heval]
  exact hout (Finset.mem_biUnion.mpr ⟨t, ht, hx⟩)

#print axioms eval_zero_outside_functional_bad_roots

/-- At most 100 candidates, each of degree at most 6, give a 600-element
root union bound. -/
theorem functional_bad_roots_card_le_600
    (ts : Finset T) (polys : T → K[X])
    (hts : ts.card ≤ 100)
    (hdegree : ∀ t ∈ ts, (polys t).natDegree ≤ 6) :
    (functionalBadRoots ts polys).card ≤ 600 := by
  calc
    (functionalBadRoots ts polys).card ≤ ts.card * 6 :=
      functional_bad_roots_card_le ts polys 6 hdegree
    _ ≤ 100 * 6 := by nlinarith [hts]
    _ = 600 := by norm_num

#print axioms functional_bad_roots_card_le_600

/-- A family of at most 600 candidates, each of degree at most 28, gives a
16,800-element root union bound. -/
theorem functional_bad_roots_card_le_16800
    (ts : Finset T) (polys : T → K[X])
    (hts : ts.card ≤ 600)
    (hdegree : ∀ t ∈ ts, (polys t).natDegree ≤ 28) :
    (functionalBadRoots ts polys).card ≤ 16800 := by
  calc
    (functionalBadRoots ts polys).card ≤ ts.card * 28 :=
      functional_bad_roots_card_le ts polys 28 hdegree
    _ ≤ 600 * 28 := by nlinarith [hts]
    _ = 16800 := by norm_num

#print axioms functional_bad_roots_card_le_16800

end AspisR1

end

import Mathlib.Algebra.Polynomial.Roots
import Mathlib.Data.Fintype.Card

/-! A finite-subfield root-counting lemma for the selected batching route.

This file is purely algebraic. It makes no probability or protocol-security
claim. -/

set_option autoImplicit false

noncomputable section

namespace AspisR1

open Polynomial

variable {K E : Type*} [Field K] [Field E] [Fintype K]

local instance : DecidableEq K := Classical.decEq K
local instance (proposition : Prop) : Decidable proposition := Classical.propDecidable proposition

/-- A nonzero polynomial over `E` has at most its degree many roots among the
images in `E` of elements of the finite field `K`. -/
theorem subfield_bad_card_le_natDegree
    (iota : K →+* E) (p : E[X]) (hp : p ≠ 0) :
    (Finset.univ.filter (fun t : K => p.eval (iota t) = 0)).card ≤ p.natDegree := by
  classical
  let bad := Finset.univ.filter (fun t : K => p.eval (iota t) = 0)
  let embedding : K ↪ E := ⟨iota, iota.injective⟩
  have hsubset : bad.map embedding ⊆ p.roots.toFinset := by
    intro y hy
    rcases Finset.mem_map.mp hy with ⟨t, ht, hty⟩
    subst y
    change iota t ∈ p.roots.toFinset
    rw [Multiset.mem_toFinset, p.mem_roots hp]
    exact (Finset.mem_filter.mp ht).2
  calc
    bad.card = (bad.map embedding).card := by simp
    _ ≤ p.roots.toFinset.card := Finset.card_le_card hsubset
    _ ≤ p.roots.card := Multiset.toFinset_card_le p.roots
    _ ≤ p.natDegree := p.card_roots'

#print axioms subfield_bad_card_le_natDegree

/-- A stated natural-number degree bound gives the same bound on bad
subfield elements. -/
theorem subfield_bad_card_le_degree
    (iota : K →+* E) (p : E[X]) (hp : p ≠ 0)
    (degreeBound : Nat) (hdegree : p.natDegree ≤ degreeBound) :
    (Finset.univ.filter (fun t : K => p.eval (iota t) = 0)).card ≤ degreeBound := by
  exact (subfield_bad_card_le_natDegree iota p hp).trans hdegree

#print axioms subfield_bad_card_le_degree

/-- Degree-21 specialization of the finite-subfield root count. -/
theorem subfield_bad_card_le_21
    (iota : K →+* E) (p : E[X]) (hp : p ≠ 0)
    (hdegree : p.natDegree ≤ 21) :
    (Finset.univ.filter (fun t : K => p.eval (iota t) = 0)).card ≤ 21 := by
  exact subfield_bad_card_le_degree iota p hp 21 hdegree

#print axioms subfield_bad_card_le_21

end AspisR1

end

  if h : bs.length ≤ D then some ⟨bs, h⟩ else none

  apply Fin.ext
  simp [label]

    σ := SelectedChallengeMap.sigma

import R1InputWitnessCheck
import R1AppendPath

/-! Public output-pair, new-root and carry-frontier binding required by J1.R2.
The recurrence is the circuit's literal frozen-table recurrence. Non-carry
frontier validation and the chronological tree invariant are separate. -/
set_option autoImplicit false
namespace AspisR1.SpendRelation
open R0P
variable {K : Type} [Field K] [DecidableEq K]

def outputPair (pub : Public K) : Option (Digest K) :=
  match pub.variant with
  | .privateTransfer => pub.recipient.map (fun r => nodeCompress r pub.change)
  | .withdrawal => some (nodeCompress pub.change (fun _ => 0))

def AppendBinding (pub : Public K) : Prop :=
  ∃ pair, outputPair pub = some pair ∧
    pub.nextRoot = AppendPath.pathPrefix pub pair 20 ∧
    ∀ hc : digestCarry pub.nextPairIndex < 20,
      pub.nextFrontier ⟨digestCarry pub.nextPairIndex, hc⟩ =
        AppendPath.pathPrefix pub pair (digestCarry pub.nextPairIndex)

def appendCheck (pub : Public K) : Bool :=
  match outputPair pub with
  | none => false
  | some pair =>
      InputWitnessCheck.digestEqCheck pub.nextRoot (AppendPath.pathPrefix pub pair 20) &&
        if hc : digestCarry pub.nextPairIndex < 20 then
          InputWitnessCheck.digestEqCheck
            (pub.nextFrontier ⟨digestCarry pub.nextPairIndex, hc⟩)
            (AppendPath.pathPrefix pub pair (digestCarry pub.nextPairIndex))
        else true

theorem appendCheck_eq_true_iff (pub : Public K) :
    appendCheck pub = true ↔ AppendBinding pub := by
  cases hp : outputPair pub with
  | none => simp [appendCheck, AppendBinding, hp]
  | some pair =>
      by_cases hc : digestCarry pub.nextPairIndex < 20
      · simp [appendCheck, AppendBinding, hp, hc,
          InputWitnessCheck.digestEqCheck_eq_true_iff]
      · simp [appendCheck, AppendBinding, hp, hc,
          InputWitnessCheck.digestEqCheck_eq_true_iff]

#print axioms appendCheck_eq_true_iff
end AspisR1.SpendRelation

import R1InputWitnessCheck
import PublicOptionShape
import AspisV8R15.ExactTowerBase

/-! An explicit witness and decidable semantic spend relation. The concrete
witness field is M31; the generic version supports the existing algebraic
extraction proofs. This is not a byte parser or a Rust refinement theorem.
Values are bounded nonnegative integers, as in the production value theorem;
the honest pair-forest builder's stronger positivity contract is separate. -/
set_option autoImplicit false
namespace AspisR1.SpendRelation

open R0P AspisPool.V7PairLeafOccupancy

structure Witness (K : Type) where
  inputValue : Fin (2^30)
  outputValue : Fin (2^30)
  changeValue : Fin (2^30)
  sk : R0P.Digest K
  salt : R0P.Digest K
  path : Fin 24 → Bool × R0P.Digest K
  pair : PairLeaf K
  recipientOwner : R0P.Digest K
  recipientSalt : R0P.Digest K
  changeOwner : R0P.Digest K
  changeSalt : R0P.Digest K

variable {K : Type} [Field K] [DecidableEq K]

def recipientCommitment (pub : Public K) (w : Witness K) : R0P.Digest K :=
  noteCommitment w.recipientOwner (w.outputValue.val : K) pub.assetId w.recipientSalt

def changeCommitment (pub : Public K) (w : Witness K) : R0P.Digest K :=
  noteCommitment w.changeOwner (w.changeValue.val : K) pub.assetId w.changeSalt

def variantOutput (pub : Public K) (w : Witness K) : Prop :=
  match pub.variant with
  | .privateTransfer => pub.recipient = some (recipientCommitment pub w)
  | .withdrawal => pub.withdrawalAmount = some (w.outputValue.val : K)

def Rspend (pub : Public K) (w : Witness K) : Prop :=
  PublicOptionShape.canonical pub ∧
    InputWitnessCore.Relation pub (w.inputValue.val : K) w.sk w.salt w.path w.pair ∧
    w.inputValue.val = w.outputValue.val + w.changeValue.val ∧
    pub.change = changeCommitment pub w ∧
    variantOutput pub w

def variantOutputCheck (pub : Public K) (w : Witness K) : Bool :=
  match pub.variant with
  | .privateTransfer =>
      match pub.recipient with
      | none => false
      | some recipient => InputWitnessCheck.digestEqCheck recipient (recipientCommitment pub w)
  | .withdrawal =>
      match pub.withdrawalAmount with
      | none => false
      | some amount => decide (amount = (w.outputValue.val : K))

def check (pub : Public K) (w : Witness K) : Bool :=
  PublicOptionShape.check pub &&
    InputWitnessCheck.check pub (w.inputValue.val : K) w.sk w.salt w.path w.pair &&
    decide (w.inputValue.val = w.outputValue.val + w.changeValue.val) &&
    InputWitnessCheck.digestEqCheck pub.change (changeCommitment pub w) &&
    variantOutputCheck pub w

/-- The concrete relation uses canonical M31 field elements for every key,
salt, path digest, pair coordinate and output owner. -/
abbrev Wspend := Witness AspisV8R15.ExactTowerBase.M31Exact

def checkM31 (pub : Public AspisV8R15.ExactTowerBase.M31Exact) (w : Wspend) : Bool :=
  check pub w

theorem variantOutputCheck_eq_true_iff (pub : Public K) (w : Witness K) :
    variantOutputCheck pub w = true ↔ variantOutput pub w := by
  cases hv : pub.variant with
  | privateTransfer =>
      cases hr : pub.recipient <;>
        simp [variantOutputCheck, variantOutput, hv, hr,
          InputWitnessCheck.digestEqCheck_eq_true_iff]
  | withdrawal =>
      cases ha : pub.withdrawalAmount <;>
        simp [variantOutputCheck, variantOutput, hv, ha]

theorem check_eq_true_iff (pub : Public K) (w : Witness K) :
    check pub w = true ↔ Rspend pub w := by
  simp only [check, Bool.and_eq_true, decide_eq_true_eq,
    PublicOptionShape.check_eq_true_iff, InputWitnessCheck.check_eq_true_iff,
    InputWitnessCheck.digestEqCheck_eq_true_iff, variantOutputCheck_eq_true_iff,
    Rspend, and_assoc]

theorem input_note_extracted (pub : Public K) (w : Witness K) (A : Trace K)
    (hvalue : A 10 1008 = (w.inputValue.val : K)) (h : Rspend pub w) :
    R0P.InputNoteExtracted pub A := by
  refine ⟨w.sk, w.salt, w.path, h.2.1.nullifier, ?_⟩
  rw [hvalue]
  exact h.2.1.membership

theorem integer_bounds (pub : Public K) (w : Witness K) (h : Rspend pub w) :
    w.inputValue.val < 2^30 ∧ w.outputValue.val < 2^30 ∧ w.changeValue.val < 2^30 ∧
      w.inputValue.val = w.outputValue.val + w.changeValue.val :=
  ⟨w.inputValue.isLt, w.outputValue.isLt, w.changeValue.isLt, h.2.2.1⟩

#print axioms input_note_extracted
#print axioms integer_bounds
#print axioms variantOutputCheck_eq_true_iff
#print axioms check_eq_true_iff
end AspisR1.SpendRelation

import R1SelectedChallengeMapCore

/-! Selected challenge maps for the 33-row mathematical transcript. Rows 25
and 26 carry the embedded QM31 parameter; their typed circle views apply the
existing row-specific total circle maps. Row 31's field value is unused by
the query sampler and is totalized to zero. This is not Rust refinement or
an instantiation of the complete message/decision/classifier protocol. -/
set_option autoImplicit false
noncomputable section

/-! Selected challenge maps for the 33-row mathematical transcript. Rows 25
and 26 carry the embedded QM31 parameter; their typed circle views apply the
existing row-specific total circle maps. Row 31's field value is unused by

def sigma (i : Nat) (s : State) : WideExact :=
  if i = 27 then R0C.ModuloField.gamma s
  else if i = 28 ∨ i = 29 ∨ i = 30 then R0C.ModuloField.ordinary s
  else if i = 31 then 0
  else semChal s

def rhoOf (x : WideExact) : AspisV8R15.ExactTowerBase.QM31Exact := x.re

theorem semantic_row (i : Nat) (hi : i < 25) (s : State) :
    sigma i s = semChal s := by
  have h27 : i ≠ 27 := by omega
  have hopen : ¬ (i = 28 ∨ i = 29 ∨ i = 30) := by omega
  have h31 : i ≠ 31 := by omega
  simp only [sigma, if_neg h27, if_neg hopen, if_neg h31]

theorem first_circle_view (s : State) :

  rw [(circle_parameter_rows s).1]
  rfl

theorem second_circle_view (s : State) :

  rw [(circle_parameter_rows s).2]
  rfl

theorem rho_row (s : State) :
